children: Alphabet (GOOGL, Financials) is nearing the launch of its next-generation Gemini 4 AI model as Google DeepMind takes the system into the last stages of development.

"We are now in the early stages of post-training for Gemini 4," Koray Kavukcuoglu, head of Google DeepMind, stated Wednesday. That procedure includes adjusting the base model to make it more reliable and perform better before it is deployed more widely.
The timing is crucial as Google is still battling OpenAI and Anthropic for market share in AI models, while Meta is also attracting attention with its AI solutions.

For Google, Gemini is a growing piece of its overall AI strategy, which also includes consumer products, search and cloud services. The corporation has another chance to enhance its capabilities and stay competitive in the AI arena with a new model.
But the statement does not reveal the exact capabilities, pricing or release date of Gemini 4.
The next catalyst will be the formal debut of Gemini 4 and the first indications of how the model stacks up against competing systems from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta.

title: Google's Gemini 4 Just Sent a New Signal to AI Investors
